<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Recoome''' is a member of the '''Ginyu Force''', Frieza's elite squad. In [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion|Frieza's Invasion]], the raid of [[Special:MyLanguage/Namek|Planet Namek]], he arrives in the final wave with the rest of the squad. After [[Special:MyLanguage/Ginyu|Ginyu]], he hits the hardest in melee.
</translate>

<translate>
== In raids == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
The whole Ginyu Force is the boss group of wave 5: [[Special:MyLanguage/Guldo|Guldo]], Recoome, [[Special:MyLanguage/Burter|Burter]], [[Special:MyLanguage/Jeice|Jeice]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Ginyu|Ginyu]], escorted by 15 [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Soldier|Frieza Soldiers]]. The five stay dormant until the soldiers are dead, but attacking one wakes it up early. Like every raid boss, they glow red.

<!--T:9-->
In the raid Recoome has 10,000 health, 90 melee damage and 50 ki damage, and fights on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|Smart]] AI tier, like Guldo; the other three are Elite. These are the defaults, before the story difficulty multiplier of the player who started the raid (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Raids#Difficulty|Raids]]); the number of participants doesn't change them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
* '''Flight:''' Recoome flies and follows you into the air.
* '''Ki Explosion:''' a pink burst of ki around himself.
* '''Aerial Combo:''' he knocks you into the air, appears above you and slams you back down.
* He doesn't dodge.
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops == <!--T:12-->

<!--T:13-->
Recoome drops nothing. Clearing the raid rewards everyone still fighting (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza's Invasion#Rewards|Frieza's Invasion]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Frieza Saga|Frieza Saga]], the quest '''Recoome's Rampage''' has you defeat him on Namek's Ajissa Plains. After the saga quest '''Captain Ginyu''', the side quest '''Ginyu Force Stragglers''' sends him and [[Special:MyLanguage/Guldo|Guldo]] after you again on Namek (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sidequests|Sidequests]]).
</translate>
